description: Defines the BlitGL class, a helper for blitting textures in OpenGL, including methods for copying images, subimages, and clearing textures and framebuffers.

classes.name: BlitGL
classes.description: A helper class for performing texture blitting operations in OpenGL, managing shader programs, textures, and framebuffers.

methods.name: copyImageToLUMAWorkaroundTexture
methods.description: Copies an image to a LUMA workaround texture.

methods.name: copySubImageToLUMAWorkaroundTexture
methods.description: Copies a sub-image to a LUMA workaround texture.

methods.name: blitColorBufferWithShader
methods.description: Blits a color buffer using a shader program.

methods.name: copySubTexture
methods.description: Copies a sub-texture from source to destination.

methods.name: copySubTextureCPUReadback
methods.description: Copies a sub-texture with CPU readback.

methods.name: clearRenderableTextureAlphaToOne
methods.description: Sets alpha of a texture to one.
